text: 国家统计局：9月汽油价格同比上涨16.6%，涨幅比上月扩大7.3个百分点，影响CPI同比上涨约0.47个百分点，带动能源价格涨幅由上月的4.1%扩大至本月的7.3%
text_en: National Bureau of Statistics: In September, gasoline prices rose 16.6% year-on-year, an increase 7.3 percentage points wider than last month, contributing about 0.47 percentage points to the year-on-year CPI increase, driving the increase in energy prices from 4.1% last month to 7.3% this month
